question: Has LUVO been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns LUVO now?
markdown:
Because "LUVO" can refer to multiple distinct corporate entities and brands, ownership depends entirely on the specific industry context:

-   **Acquisition Status:** Acquired by [⁠GovGrant](https://sourceadvisors.co.uk/insights/latest-thinking/our-people/luvo-acquisition-one-year-on/) in 2021.

-   **Current Ownership:** Owned by GovGrant (part of the wider Source Advisors network). [](https://sourceadvisors.co.uk/insights/latest-thinking/our-people/luvo-acquisition-one-year-on/)

### Luvo Medical Technologies (Aesthetic & Medical Devices)

-   **Acquisition Status:** Operates as a subsidiary/brand line.

-   **Current Ownership:** Owned by Clarion Medical Technologies Inc.. [](https://www.thenewswire.com/press-releases/1AJ6Fe1EV-aequus-announces-sale-of-zimed-pf-to-luvo-medical-technologies.html)

### Luvo Inc. (Nutrition-Focused Frozen Foods)

-   **Status:** Launched in 2013 and led by former Lululemon CEO Christine Day. It has not reported any major corporate acquisitions, operating independently as a private health-frozen food brand backed by private investors and athlete brand ambassadors. [](https://www.fastcompany.com/3050162/how-luvo-is-bringing-the-heat-to-frozen-foods)
